reference.configuration: Emden (1925), ONI 204, August 1942. Two funnels and eight single 150 mm guns, arranged as two forward, two aft and four side positions; four torpedo tubes. Wartime mast and light-AA details are retained as a dated recognition reference rather than an as-launched claim.
